hook: One innocent loop can hide O(N squared) complexity.
hookText: One innocent loop can hide O(N squared) complexity.

beats.say: The code works instantly for 100 messages, but run it on 100,000 and it becomes agonizingly slow, taking seconds or even minutes for work that should take milliseconds.
beats.statLabel: messages turn the loop agonizingly slow

beats.say: Python strings are immutable, so every plus-equals allocates a new block, copies the whole report, appends the message, and discards the old string.
By iteration 10,000 it copies 9,999 characters before adding one more, so doubling the messages quadruples the time; the fix is to collect them in a list and join them.
